intro.text: A kandra of the Fifth Generation who sided with KanPaar and the Second Generation against the First, and guards the imprisoned Firsts.

items.text: When KanPaar and the Seconds staged their coup, FhorKood was among the Fifths who backed them; Fifths with rock bones and the Blessing of Potency helped overpower and imprison Haddek and the other Firsts, along with Sazed. He served as one of the prisoners' guards.

After TenSoon broke into the Homeland and freed Sazed, FhorKood and other Fifths came to subdue him, not expecting Sazed's Feruchemy, which broke most of their bones. Pinned by TenSoon, he would only insult him, until TenSoon threatened him into giving up his True Body and he slunk away. TenSoon used it to pose as FhorKood and tell the Seconds the traitor was caught.

appearance.text: Uses a True Body made of granite.

personality.text: Scorns TenSoon as a "dirty Third", though he is terrified of his abilities.
